details.description: Code Llama - Instruct 7B is Meta's instruction-tuned variant of Code Llama 7B, additionally fine-tuned to follow natural-language instructions and intended to be safer to use for code assistant and code-generation applications than the base and Python variants. Like the rest of the family it is built on Llama 2 and trained on data collected between January and July 2023. Meta's Code Llama GitHub repository was archived (read-only) on July 1, 2025, and Code Llama is absent from Meta's current model documentation, which now centers on newer Llama releases.
advantages: Scores 34.8% pass@1 on HumanEval and 44.4% pass@1 on MBPP (Meta's Code Llama paper, Table 2).
Fine-tuned for zero-shot instruction following on programming tasks, unlike the base and Python variants.
Supports code infilling (fill-in-the-middle) at the 7B size, per Meta's launch post.
disadvantages: Trained only on data collected through July 2023.
Testing focused on English; use in other languages is out of scope per Meta's model card.
Meta's Code Llama GitHub repository was archived in July 2025 and the family is absent from Meta's current model documentation.
use_cases: Code assistant and code-generation applications driven by natural-language instructions.
Interactive coding help and code explanation.
